text: Uber's 2026 proxy statement lists its greater-than-5% stockholders as of March 2, 2026: The Vanguard Group (9.34%), BlackRock (6.82%) and Capital Research Global Investors (5.78%).
short: Uber's 5%-plus stockholders are Vanguard, BlackRock and Capital Research - investment managers, no state.

source.name: Uber Technologies, Inc.: 2026 Proxy Statement (DEF 14A), Security Ownership of Certain Beneficial Owners & Management (SEC EDGAR)
source.quote: Greater than 5% Stockholders: BlackRock (17) 139,348,552 6.82% Capital Research Global Investors (18) 118,131,681 5.78% The Vanguard Group (19) 190,827,921 9.34%
